cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
REA 连续 38 天居榜首
近 7 天日均不到 28 天的一半
cover.dek: morluto/rea 今天仍是 +2801，可近 7 天日均 3,327，只有近 28 天日均 8,378 的不到一半。峰值是 10 月 12 日的 +53,916，现在已经明显降温，但还没人把它挤下去。
cover.title_en:
REA Tops the Chart for 38 Days
But the 7-day average has halved
cover.dek_en: morluto/rea gained +2801 stars today and still leads. Its 7-day average of 3,327 is under half the 28-day average of 8,378, well off the +53,916 peak on October 12.

stickers.title: 大厂入场
stickers.text: Meta、Google、Expo 的 agent-ready 项目同日上榜，astryx 日增 +2419。
stickers.text_en: Meta, Google and Expo all landed agent-ready projects today, with astryx at +2419 stars.

stickers.title: Skills 分化
stickers.text: addyosmani/agent-skills 近 4 天从 317 升到 765，anthropics/skills 则从 1,535 回落到 958。
stickers.text_en: addyosmani/agent-skills climbed from 317 to 765 over four days while anthropics/skills slid from 1,535 to 958.

stickers.title: 记忆要验证
stickers.text: WikiTrace 和 FGSE 都在处理错误经验污染记忆的问题，写入前先核对或证伪。
stickers.text_en: WikiTrace and FGSE both tackle bad experiences polluting agent memory by checking or falsifying before a write.
